snippet: Injective now hosts more than $1 billion in tokenized real estate mortgage records, making it one of the largest RWA chains by dollar value. Plans are now in motion to migrate over $10 billion in assets to Injective in the coming months, bringing standardized and auditable mortgage records onchain.
